title: LiDAR Vegetation Encroachment and Fall-In Risk for Power Line Corridors
text: public 3DEP project 2019 labels power lines. sampled classification 641 USGS 3DEP projects 2019 onward public Entwine index. None uses ASPRS wire classes; hits codes 13/14 topobathy datasets state-specific reuse (NC Phase 4 uses 13 roads). Conductor labels derived. Whether public LiDAR can decide grow-depends whether sampled conductors. Colorado barely , conductor bounded within band tens metres tall 27 30 segments stay undecidable. Nashville, 500 kV bundles sampled along almost whole line, pipeline gives measured, decisive screen. Vendor vegetation classes contain conductors. Nashville, 99.3% conductor returns (103,918 points, 15–45 m ) delivered high vegetation. canopy model built straight delivered classes flags every one 39 segments grow-; conductor returns removed, none . Random cross-validation point clouds misleads. Random folds report Colorado wire average precision 0.22; 100 m spatial blocks report 0.004. model trained Colorado doesn’t transfer Nashville (wire recall 0).
